description: Sequence input (DADA2/FASTA), BLAST search, match standardization

functions.name: read_sequence_table
functions.description: Ingest DADA2 seqtab matrix, FASTA file, or DNAStringSet; optional taxonomy join

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Sequence table, FASTA path, or DNAStringSet

output.description: Data frame with observation_id, sequence columns

functions.scaling_note: I/O bound; fast for typical eDNA datasets

functions.name: filter_sequences
functions.description: Filter ASVs by length range and minimum abundance

inputs.name: barcode_term
inputs.description: Barcode marker for auto length detection

functions.name: blast_sequences
functions.description: Remote NCBI BLAST or local rBLAST; score window filtering; taxonomy resolution

inputs.name: score_range
inputs.description: Keep hits within this % of top hit per query

output.description: Match data with score, accession, taxonomy

functions.scaling_note: Remote BLAST: ~2-5 min per batch of 50 sequences. Local: ~30 sec per 100 sequences

functions.name: standardize_match_data
functions.description: Standardize any match table to the canonical match_df format

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Raw match data with score and taxonomy columns

output.description: Standardized match object with observation_id, score, taxon_name, taxon_name_rank, taxonomy columns

functions.name: filter_redundant_hypotheses
functions.description: Drop higher-rank rows superseded by finer-rank rows within same lineage + observation_id

functions.name: read_birdnet_output
functions.description: Ingest BirdNET-Analyzer CSV results into match object format. observation_id = '{file_stem}_{start_s}-{end_s}'

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Path to BirdNET CSV file, directory of CSVs, or character vector of paths

inputs.name: top_n
inputs.description: Keep top N detections per observation_id by confidence

output.description: Match object with observation_id, score, species, genus, source_file columns

functions.name: read_animl_output
functions.description: Ingest Animl (MegaDetector + SpeciesNet) camera trap CSV into match object format. observation_id = image filename stem

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Path to Animl CSV file or data frame

inputs.name: top_n
inputs.description: Keep top N detections per image by confidence

output.description: Match object with observation_id (image stem), score, species, genus columns

functions.name: read_inaturalist_cv_output
functions.description: Read per-image JSON files from the iNaturalist CV API into match object format

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Path to JSON file or directory of JSON files

inputs.name: top_n
inputs.description: Keep top N predictions per image

output.description: Match object with observation_id, score, species, genus, common_name, taxon_rank columns

functions.name: read_speciesnet_output
functions.description: Read real SpeciesNet CLI (google/cameratrapai) predictions_json batch output into match object format. Rank-aware: taxon_rank lands wherever SpeciesNet's own conservative rollup landed (species down to class)

inputs.name: files
inputs.description: Path to SpeciesNet predictions_json file, directory of JSON files, or character vector of paths

inputs.name: top_n
inputs.description: Keep top N candidates per image (SpeciesNet returns at most 5)

inputs.name: include_coverage
inputs.description: Add coverage/detection_conf columns from MegaDetector bounding boxes

inputs.name: min_detection_conf
inputs.description: Minimum MegaDetector detection confidence to be eligible as the representative detection (only used when include_coverage=true)

output.description: Match object with observation_id, score, species, genus, family, order, class, common_name, taxon_rank, ensemble_prediction, ensemble_prediction_score, ensemble_prediction_source, lat, lon, country columns

functions.name: build_site_table
functions.description: Build a per-observation site table (observation_id, lat, lon, spatial_group_id) for spatial grouping. Reads embedded lat/lng from match_df directly if present (e.g. image EXIF GPS); otherwise requires a separately supplied site_df (e.g. from join_event_site_metadata())

inputs.name: match_df
inputs.description: Match/detection data with an id_col column; embedded lat/lng columns used automatically if present

inputs.name: site_df
inputs.description: Required only when match_df has no embedded lat/lng. Must have id_col, lat, lon columns (one or more rows per observation -- an observation detected at multiple sites gets multiple rows)

output.description: Data frame with id_col, lat, lon, observed_on, spatial_group_id (initially one default group per exact lat/lon match), spatial_group_N, is_default_group

functions.name: group_observations_by_bbox
functions.description: Interactively draw bounding-box/polygon groups over a site_table's observations, overwriting the default exact-lat/lon spatial_group_id with user-drawn groups. Requires an interactive session (Shiny gadget)

output.description: Input with spatial_group_id/spatial_group_N updated from user-drawn groups. Anything left ungrouped becomes its own single-observation group -- never dropped

functions.scaling_note: Interactive; time depends on number of groups the user draws, not data size

functions.name: assign_spatial_group
functions.description: Non-interactive alternative to group_observations_by_bbox() -- manually assign a known spatial_group_id to a set of observation_ids (e.g. groups already known from site metadata)

inputs.name: sites
inputs.description: Output of build_site_table() (must already have spatial_group_id/spatial_group_N columns)

inputs.name: spatial_group_id
inputs.description: Group label to assign to these observations

output.description: Input with the specified observations reassigned to spatial_group_id

functions.name: join_event_site_metadata
functions.description: Build a site_df (for build_site_table()'s site_df argument) from an event-level detections table joined against a user-maintained site-metadata table. Generalizes this ecosystem's blank-identification lookup-table pattern to carry site coordinates

inputs.name: site_metadata
inputs.description: User-maintained table mapping event_col to site lat/lon

inputs.name: event_col
inputs.description: Column identifying the collection event in both tables

inputs.name: id_col
inputs.description: Column identifying each observation in detections

inputs.name: control_samples
inputs.description: Event IDs to exclude as controls/blanks
